summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 11-18 m away; flattest dip mid-stretch.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12 m (at 48 m) and 18 m (at 50 m) from the kerb, plus others within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside parking; cars park along the kerb, room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a corner; low traffic.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; overnight outside those hours.

flags: Steep overall: 11% mean, 23% max; flat only near 40-58 m
Homes close on the same side
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the middle of the stretch; shade mostly from the north and east.

best_section.where: Fifth Avenue south kerb, low point between the two corners
